scenario: 今天具身赛道的主线是把机器人训练变便宜、把模型内部看清楚。SuperMimic 用一个可求导的世界模型，让人形机器人学全身动作的算力从上百张卡降到一张卡几小时；另一篇拆开三个 VLA 模型，发现动作只依赖少数几层，剪掉其余连接就能省下三分之一计算。其余几篇关注真实环境里的麻烦：旁边有人走动、长时间任务要记住环境变化、部署后不断学新技能，以及叠衣服这类软物体操作。

papers.title: SuperMimic: Scaling Humanoid Whole-Body Control with One Differentiable World Model
papers.abstract: Tracking large human-motion datasets has become the dominant route to general, expressive humanoid whole-body control, but scaling across many motions is expensive. Current pipelines use model-free reinforcement learning, either merging per-motion specialists through lossy distillation, or brute-forcing a single policy with cluster-scale compute. SuperMimic amortizes learning across all motions with one differentiable world model of their shared dynamics, fit from logged transitions of a standard rigid-body simulator. The world model and the tracking policy train together in one loop, and backpropagation-through-time over short imagined rollouts gives the policy analytic gradients. Fast imagined rollouts and analytic gradients make policy learning efficient. In 3 hours on a single GPU, SuperMimic surpasses the return of a state-of-the-art motion tracker baseline trained for 7 days on 128 GPUs. It reduces GPU-hours by more than $1000\times$ and fails on only 25 of 129,514 benchmark motions, versus 179 failures for the baseline. After 9.8 hours on two GPUs, SuperMimic achieves zero failures. From 1 to 264 hours of motion, the world model's prediction error stays stable, and GPU-hours to a target return grow slowly. Our policy transfers to a physical Unitree G1 across diverse and acrobatic motions. SuperMimic removes compute as the bottleneck to scaling humanoid whole-body control, making it practical to measure motion-tracking scaling laws.
papers.authors: Qiayuan Liao, Yiyang Shao, Junfeng Long, Kevin Zakka, Roberto Horowitz, Pieter Abbeel, Koushil Sreenath
papers.summary: 让人形机器人跟着大量人体动作数据学全身控制，现在的主流做法很费算力：最强的动作跟踪器 SONIC（此前公开的、用 PPO 在集群上训练的方案）要在 128 张 GPU 上训练约 7 天。SuperMimic 的出发点是，动作虽然千差万别，机器人身体的物理规律是同一套。它先用仿真器的日志数据学一个可求导的世界模型，再让策略在这个模型里做短程想象，直接对动作求梯度。结果是单卡训练 3 小时，回报就超过了 SONIC，GPU 时数省了 1000 多倍。==瓶颈从算力转到了动作数据本身==，扩更多动作变得便宜。

papers.title: Causal Analysis of Robot Foundation Models Enables Efficiency Gains
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are a promising approach to general purpose robot manipulation. While the internal computation of vision-language models, which compose the backbone of VLAs, has been studied extensively, less is known about how their perceptual and semantic representations are transformed into action in VLA models. We study this question mechanistically in three frontier VLA models ($\pi_{0.5}$, MolmoAct2, and MolmoBot) by analyzing the causal pathways through which the input image and the instruction shape actions. Across the three models, activation patching shows that causally relevant information influences the action expert (AE) through a narrow band of mid-to-late cross-attention layers, which we term the action-conditioning interface. The content of this information changes with token and layer within the model. Early-to-mid layer representations of the target noun token determine which object is selected, whereas mid-to-late layers carry the spatial information in text tokens that redirects the movement when patched. Where spatial information is stored in prompt tokens various based on the architecture. In MolmoAct2 the model forms task-conditioned representations at the text positions that follow the instruction, whereas $\pi_{0.5}$ additionally stores this information at image token positions. We show that these findings can be translated directly into improving model efficiency. We find that restricting MolmoBot's action expert conditioning to only 3 out of 36 layers reduces inference FLOPs by up to $33\%$ while maintaining comparable task success with the default model across 3,000 evaluation episodes ($46.7\%$ vs. $46.9\%$), and the same principle carries over to real-robot deployment of $\pi_{0.5}$.
papers.authors: Aiden Swann, Mathilde Papillon, Mozes Jacobs, Siddharth Boppana, Tal Haklay, Eric Bigelow, Andrew Lee, Conor Watts, Thomas Icard, Mac Schwager, Owen Lewis, Jack Merullo, Ekdeep Singh Lubana, Atticus Geiger, Thomas Fel, Matthew Kowal
papers.summary: VLA 模型的动作模块通常在每一层都去读语言模型主干的信息，但其实只有中后段很窄的几层真正影响动作。作者在三个开源 VLA 模型上做了这样的实验：桌上有香蕉和苹果，一次让机器人拿香蕉，另一次两者换个位置、让它拿苹果，把前一次某一层的内部激活抄进后一次，看机器人会不会改去拿香蕉，逐层试下来得出了这个结论。指令里目标物体那个词在前中层决定抓哪个物体，往哪边动的空间信息则在中后层。按这个发现，只让 MolmoBot 的动作模块读其中 3 层，推理计算量最多省 33%，成功率几乎不变。

papers.title: Compositional Diffusion Policy for Vision–Language–Action Agents
papers.authors: Yuxuan Xu, Jianzhe Gao, Hanlin Kong, Zhen Yin, Yonggen Ling, Wenguan Wang
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) agents face a combinatorial task space where semantic and physical requirements are recombined in novel ways. However, existing holistic policies typically entangle them in a single latent representation, limiting generalization to unseen compositions and compromising physical feasibility. To this end, this work proposes an energy-based compositional diffusion policy that models robot action trajectory generation with distinct semantic and physical energy terms. Specifically, the agent factorizes multimodal inputs into grounded semantic factors and models them as implicit semantic energies. In parallel, it formulates physical constraints, including motion smoothness and kinematic manipulability, as explicit differentiable energies. These energies are jointly combined to guide trajectory generation toward both task satisfaction and physical feasibility. Our agent shows consistent improvements in compositional generalization and physical validity in real-world experiments and across some public benchmarks. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each component. The code will be released. Comprehensive ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of each component. The code will be released.
papers.summary: 机器人执行一条指令时，要做什么和动作能不能做到，是两类不同的要求，而且会被重新组合成没见过的任务。现有策略把它们混在一个表示里学，遇到新组合就容易泛化不好，生成的动作也可能不平滑或机械臂够不着。这篇把动作轨迹的生成拆成几项能量相加：指令里的物体、位置等语义各对应一项，由网络学出来，给候选轨迹打分，越符合这条要求分数越好；动作平滑、机械臂好不好发力这些物理约束写成可求导的显式项，一起引导扩散模型生成轨迹。==拆开以后，新组合只是把已有的几项重新加起来==，真机和公开基准上组合泛化和动作可行性都更好。

papers.title: Online Robot Manipulation Error Detection and Description
papers.authors: Yung-Shun Chan, Kuniaki Saito, Cristian Camilo Beltran-Hernandez, Jeremy Siburian, Masashi Hamaya, Chun-Yi Lee
papers.abstract: Detecting and describing failure events during robot manipulation is critical for safe autonomous deployment, yet existing methods either reduce failures to per-frame binary scores or require the complete episode. We formulate robot failure detection as an online video temporal grounding problem, where the model processes streaming video and outputs both the temporal boundaries and a natural-language description of each failure event as it unfolds. Our framework operates chunk-by-chunk with a memory bank over previously observed frames. To bridge the domain gap between general video understanding and manipulation reasoning, we design an automated pipeline that converts robot trajectory datasets into temporal grounding annotations for pre-training, which yields a 73% relative improvement in temporal localization. On our evaluation benchmark, the full model outperforms the strongest online grounding baseline with an mIoU of 0.232 (versus 0.194) and produces failure descriptions with a CIDEr score of 0.854. We release the generated dataset and the human-annotated benchmark to support future research on real-time robot failure detection, description, and recovery.
papers.summary: 机器人操作出错时，现有方法要么每帧只给一个出错或没出错的分数，要么要等整段视频录完才能分析。这篇把出错检测改成边看边判：模型一段一段读实时视频，用一个记忆库存下看过的画面，出错时同时给出这次失误从哪一刻开始到哪一刻结束，以及一句话描述发生了什么。通用视频模型不懂机器人操作，作者先拿现有机器人数据集额外做了一轮预训练。最终模型定位失误时间段的 mIoU 是 0.232，最强的在线基线是 0.194。对做线上监控的人来说，能实时说出哪里错了，比事后打分更有用。

papers.title: HARP-Bench: Benchmarking Robot Manipulation Around Active Humans
papers.authors: Qinhong Zhou, Riley Zong, Chunru Lin, Diyi Hu, Shivraj Singh Bhatti, Hongxin Zhang, Lin Qiu, Hanqing Zeng, Chuang Gan
papers.abstract: Recent robot manipulation benchmarks have enabled systematic evaluation of general-purpose robot policies across diverse objects, scenes, instructions, and embodiments. However, most existing benchmarks still assume that the robot is the only active agent and that task semantics are determined primarily by the instruction and object state. This assumption overlooks a common source of real-world variation: humans actively sharing the workspace. In such settings, humans may reveal an implicit goal, temporarily change object availability, complete part of the task, or constrain safe robot motion while working nearby. We introduce HARP-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating robot manipulation policies in workspaces shared with active humans. HARP-Bench treats human activity as part of the manipulation problem, rather than as background scene variation. It organizes human-present manipulation into four conditions: Cueing, Interruption, Contribution, and Co-presence. Each condition is instantiated as paired variants of everyday manipulation tasks, enabling controlled comparison between standard manipulation and human-present manipulation. HARP-Bench also includes an interactive data collection pipeline for gathering demonstrations in dynamic human-present settings. We evaluate a diverse set of policies on HARP-Bench, including VLA models, imitation-learning methods, and heuristic policies. Our results show that human-present task variations pose a significant challenge for current robot policies. We further show that training on demonstrations collected with HARP-Bench improves performance under these human-present conditions. Real-world experiments further confirm the validity of HARP-Bench, and our generated data can improve policy behavior when humans actively affect task execution.
papers.summary: 现有机器人操作基准大多默认工作台前只有机器人在动，可真实环境里人常常就在旁边：用手一指暗示想要哪个，临时拿走要用的东西，顺手把任务做了一半，或者站在机械臂要经过的地方。HARP-Bench 把这些情况当成任务本身的一部分，分成提示、打断、帮忙和同处一个空间四类，每个日常任务都配一个没人在场的对照版本，方便直接比较。作者测了 VLA、模仿学习和规则策略，有人在场时它们都明显变差；用这个基准采集的演示数据训练后，这些情况下的表现会提升，真机实验也印证了这一点。

papers.title: Towards Human-like Physical Intelligence: Lifelong Vision-Language-Action Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Yao He, Gan Sun, Wenqi Liang, Fazeng Li, Yang Cong
papers.abstract: Similar to the natural capabilities of humans to sequentially learn new tasks, robots with Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model should possess lifelong learning ability to learn a new task when deployed for open-world environment. However, most recently-proposed lifelong learning models aim to effectively learn the current task (plasticity) or maintain high accuracy on the previous tasks (stability), the plasticity-stability trade-off remains largely unsolved in robot manipulation models. To address this fundamental challenge, we propose a cache-efficient lifelong Vision-Language-Action learning framework for robotic manipulation (i.e., LIFELONGVLA), which alleviates plasticity-stability trade-off with a dual-timescale adaptation mechanism while achieving low-cost robotic deployment with a cache-efficient replay strategy. More concretely, we propose a dual-timescale LoRA gating module to decompose VLA adaptation into two lightweight pathways: a short-term adapter for plasticity and a long-term adapter for stable consolidation. These pathways are integrated via a task-aware gate, which could enable explicit control of the plasticity–stability trade-off. In the skill replay phase, a cache-efficient stochastic replay strategy is proposed to preserve more balanced retention signals without full-trajectory storage. To the end, experiments show that LIFELONGVLA outperforms existing baselines, demonstrating efficient skill expansion, robust retention of learned manipulation behaviors, and less reliance on retraining reliance for real-world deployment on xArm robot.
papers.summary: 机器人部署后要不断学新技能，可一学新的就忘旧的，想记牢旧的又学不进新的。LifelongVLA 给 VLA 模型挂了两组 LoRA：一组只用新任务的数据训练，学得快；另一组只用旧技能的复习样本和蒸馏信号训练，学习率更低，变得慢，用来守住学过的东西。一个门控按当前输入决定两组各占多少。复习时每个旧技能只随机留少量样本，不存整条带图像的演示。依次学完多个任务后，平均成功率 83.2%，比最强基线高 13 个点，遗忘率也低了 8.2 个点。

papers.title: HARP-VLA: Human-Robot Aligned Representation Learning for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.authors: Xiang Zhu, Puzhen Yuan, Yichen Liu, Jianyu Chen
papers.abstract: Learning generalizable vision-language-action (VLA) models from large-scale human videos is promising but challenging due to cross-embodiment discrepancies in both visual observations and executable actions. While latent action models reduce the action execution gap by learning action abstractions, they still rely on visual features. Thus, misaligned human and robot visual representations can lead to inconsistencies in policy inputs and induce domain-dependent latent actions, hindering effective co-training with human videos. To address this, we propose HARP, a human-robot aligned representation learning framework for more effective VLA pretraining from human videos. Specifically, HARP uses limited paired human-robot demonstrations as cross-embodiment bridges and abundant unpaired human and robot videos as a scalable dynamics supervision data source. It trains a robot-adapted visual encoder and a latent action model with manipulation-centric auxiliary cues and a source-relative pair-discriminative alignment loss, which adapts robot representations toward human semantics while preserving pair-level discrimination. The learned aligned vision encoder and latent action model provide a unified vision and action representation for VLA-style policy learning, where human and robot videos provide vision-language-to-latent-action supervision and a lightweight robot action head grounds latent actions into executable commands. Experiments on feature visualization, simulation, and realworld manipulation show improved human-robot alignment and downstream policy performance, achieving 4.481 average length on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D and a 7.1\% realworld success rate gain over the strongest baseline.
papers.summary: 用海量人类操作视频来训练机器人策略，难点不只是人手和机械臂动作不同，还在于同样的操作，人和机器人的画面会被视觉编码器编到两片互不相干的特征里，混在一起训练效果就打折扣。HARP 用少量人和机器人做同一件事的配对演示当桥梁，把机器人的视觉特征往人类那边对齐，同时让不同配对的演示彼此仍然分得开；大量不配对的视频则用来训练一个模型，从相邻两帧画面的变化里推出这一步做了什么动作，得到一种人和机器人通用的动作编码，策略先学预测这种编码，再由一个小模块把它转成机器人的控制指令。对齐之后，人类视频才真正帮上忙：在 CALVIN 上平均能连续完成 4.481 个任务，真机成功率比最强基线高 7.1%。

papers.title: SERF: Spatiotemporal Environment and Robot Feature Map for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.authors: Sunghwan Kim, Byeonghyun Pak, Kehan Long, Yulun Tian, Nikolay Atanasov
papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot mobile manipulation requires continual reasoning about localization, environment changes, and task progress, all of which are challenging to infer from image observations alone. In this paper, we show that conditioning a mobile manipulation policy on a spatiotemporal feature map improves reasoning over long horizons. The map represents the environment and the articulated robot body as neural points in a shared latent space and is updated online from egocentric observations and proprioceptive state. We update the environment neural points using object-level rigid tracking and the robot neural points using forward kinematics. We use our spatiotemporal environment and robot feature (SERF) map as a state input to a vision-language-action (VLA) model by extracting map tokens from multiple reference frames and spatial scales, providing the policy with both local and global context. We demonstrate SERF on BEHAVIOR-1K, a benchmark for long-horizon mobile manipulation in household environments. Experiments show that the SERF VLA policy outperforms image-only baselines, reaches subgoals faster by following more direct trajectories, improves robustness to scene-configuration shifts, and recovers from object-drop failures.
papers.summary: 移动机器人做收拾房间这种长任务，要一直知道自己在哪、周围什么变了、任务做到哪一步，只看当前画面很难答上来。SERF 维护一张随时间更新的特征地图，把环境里的物体和机器人自己的身体都表示成同一空间里的一堆特征点：物体动了就跟着刚体跟踪更新，机器人的点按关节角度算出位置。VLA 策略除了图像，还分别以机械手和机器人底座为中心，从这张图上取近处和大范围的特征当输入。在 BEHAVIOR-1K 的三个家务任务上，平均完成进度从 44.0% 提到 58.7%，去没到过的区域时提升更明显。

papers.title: In-Context Learning World Models for Robot Dual-Arm Manipulation of Soft Garment with Partial Observations
papers.abstract: Robust manipulation of soft objects, such as garments, is a critical skill for service and household robots to adopt, but remains challenging due to its high-dimensional state space, and material-dependent deformations. Humans address this challenge by using mental world models that "imagine" the shape and material properties from partial observations, which enables them to predict how actions affect future states. As such, embedding such world models in robots allows for better generalization in manipulating a wide variety of garments in the real world. However, learned world models typically require large amounts of real world data that is strenuous to collect, and a mechanism to infer latent properties that govern dynamics. We present a Soft-Object World Model that performs generative full-state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction using a transformer backbone trained on large-scale simulated soft object interactions, with measures to mitigate the sim-to-real gap. By learning to infer latent shape and material cues through in-context learning over a variable-length partial point-cloud history, the model generalizes across robot embodiments, material parameters, garment types and shapes, and manipulation coordination modes without weight updates. The world model is then integrated with a Goal-Conditioned action planner for motion synthesis. We validate the approach in simulation and real world for bimanual garment folding, reporting improvements in reconstruction fidelity, prediction accuracy, and task success.
papers.authors: Hengyi Sim, Quentin Rouxel, Dennis Hong, Darwin Caldwell, Fei Chen
papers.summary: 叠衣服难，是因为布料大半被自己挡住，而且同样一拉，厚布和薄布的变化完全不同。人看几眼就能猜出衣服的形状和料子，这篇让机器人也这么做：用一个 transformer 世界模型，在大量仿真布料数据上训练，输入最近几帧看到的局部点云，补全整件衣服的形状，并预测下一个动作会让它变成什么样。料子的软硬不用重新训练，模型从输入的这几帧历史里自己推出来，所以换衣服、换料子、换机器人都不用更新权重。接上一个按目标形状规划动作的模块后，双臂叠衣服在仿真和真机上的重建精度、预测准确度和成功率都有提升。

papers.title: AGIBOT introduces Worken to measure robot productivity at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026
papers.abstract:
AGIBOT unveiled its AHA3 integrated platform, GO-3 Preview, and WITA-Omni 1.0 model, as well as the G2 Max robot and Link-U OS 1.0 framework.

The post AGIBOT introduces Worken to measure robot productivity at AGIBOT Innovation Day 2026 appeared first on The Robot Report.
papers.summary: 机器人公司常拿造了多少台、卖了多少台说话，但这说明不了机器人到底干了多少活。智元在 2026 创新日上提出 Worken，名字取自 Work 和 Token，意思是有效的智能工作时长。它由三项相乘：真正在现场干活的机器人数量、自主工作的时长（不算开机待着的时间）、以及和人工标准相比的产出效率。智元还发布了新的机器人、模型和操作系统框架。这个指标目前只是一个提议，但它把衡量重点从出货量转到了实际产出上，对评估机器人部署是否划算更有参考意义。
